results.title: Britney Spears reveals botox mishap left her eye drooping for four weeks, warns fans: ‘Be careful’
results.description: Britney Spears has opened up about a botox procedure that went wrong, revealing that her left eye drooped for nearly four weeks after she was injected with too much botox.
